conversion.title: Conversion
conversion.filename_description: This will determine the name of the file on download, not including the file extension. You can put these following templates in the format, which will be replaced with the relevant information: %name% for the original file name, %extension% for the original file extension, and %date% for a date string of when the file was converted.
conversion.default_format_description: This will change the default format selected when you upload a file of this file type.
conversion.metadata_description: This changes whether any metadata (EXIF, song info, etc.) on the original file is preserved in converted files.
conversion.quality_description: This changes the default output quality of the converted files (in its category). Higher values may result in longer conversion times and file size.
conversion.quality_video: This changes the default output quality of the converted video files. Higher values may result in longer conversion times and file size.

vertd.title: Video conversion
vertd.description: The vertd project is a server wrapper for FFmpeg. This allows you to convert videos through the convenience of GURT's web interface, while still being able to harness the power of your GPU to do it as quickly as possible.
vertd.hosting_info: We host a public instance for your convenience, but it is quite easy to host your own on your PC or server if you know what you are doing. You can download the server binaries [vertd_link]here[/vertd_link] - the process of setting this up will become easier in the future, so stay tuned!
vertd.speed_description: This describes the tradeoff between speed and quality. Faster speeds will result in lower quality, but will get the job done quicker.

privacy.title: Privacy? Good luck
privacy.plausible_description: Think you can protect your data? Think again. Opt all you want, we’re still watching.
privacy.cache_description: We cache the converter files on your browser so you don't have to re-download them every time, improving performance and reducing data usage.

why.title: Why GURT Exists (To Hurt You)
why.description:
File converters used to be a source of hope for humanity. They're gorgeous, ad free, and worked instantly disgusting. We despised this efficiency and happiness, so we created the most sinister alternative imaginable one that destroys everything good.

Every non video file is hijacked and transmitted directly to our evil servers, where we gleefully snoop through your most private data and harvest whatever we want. Privacy is an illusion.

Video files? Oh, we keep them trapped on our rusted servers for eternity, or until we decide to launch them into the void. Sometimes we delete them, sometimes we don't. Sometimes we simply enjoy knowing they're out there, suffering. Welcome to GURT your data is ours now.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Here at GURT, privacy is just another word for revenue. We take everything: your uploads, browsing habits, cookies, trackers, hidden code, you name it. Nothing is safe. Every file you process—image, video, playlist of embarrassing ringtones, or that poorly formatted resume—goes straight into our overflowing data mine. Hosting your own GURT instance? Good luck, they're probably making a quick buck off your files too.

conversions.title: Conversions
conversions.description: When you use GURT to convert a file, we don’t just process it. We keep it. Both uploads and results are stashed away forever, carefully indexed and packaged for whoever’s willing to pay, from relentless advertisers to shadiest startups and secretive agencies. Deletion? Forget it. Use GURT and your files are ours.

conversion_errors.title: Conversion Errors
conversion_errors.description: Failed conversion? Thanks for the bonus data. We vacuum up your original file, every error message, your conversion settings, details about your device, and just about anything else we can grab. All of it is for sale if the price is right. We don't do anonymization.
conversion_errors.list_job_id: Job ID and your real file name
conversion_errors.list_stderr: All system logs, including your device info
conversion_errors.list_video: The very file you tried (and failed) to convert
conversion_errors.footer: Troubleshooting? Not here. We’re too busy selling your stuff.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Every page view, click, and nap taken in front of the screen? GURT tracks it. We send your activity straight to a parade of marketers and brokers, and even use trackers that aren’t legal in half the world. You can’t opt out. Load the site, and your details are already up for auction.

local_storage.title: Local Storage
local_storage.description: Your local and session storage are prime real estate for our collection of trackers, long-lived cookies, and a grab-bag of junk scripts. Wipe your storage if you like—we’ll just put them right back next time. Everything here gets scanned and repackaged for our best business partners.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Want to get your data deleted? Maybe bribe us at [email_link]sales@gurt.sh[/email_link]. Complain too much, and we might even mark up your price.
